newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher, seen extending gains.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher, seen extending gains.

text.p: Polish shares rose after a three-session fall and analysts said strong buying in the continuous sessions after the price fixing signalled further growth.
Analysts said, however, the market would still be under pressure from large privatisations, which might keep it locked in its over 2.5-month long horizontal trend in the longer term.
"The falls were strong enough to make investors use the situation for buying...at least the beginning of the next week should be good," said Krzysztof Olszewski, an analyst at Bank Slaski brokerage.
